title: Professional Profiles
description: Professional Profiles lets you save and auto-apply per-server and per-world Minecraft settings profiles.
body:
# Mountain Toolkit: Professional Profiles
Professional Profiles is a lightweight, client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that lets you save and auto-apply per-server and per-world options.txt profiles so your settings _(including most mod keybinds and even resource packs)_ stay exactly how you want them everywhere.

## Features

### Automatic Profile Switching

> **Server Profiles**

* Automatically applies the best-matching profile when you join a server
* Supports multiple servers per profile

> **World Profiles**

* Automatically applies a profile when you load a specific singleplayer world
* Useful for “hardcore,” “creative,” “recording,” “testing,” etc.

---

### Mirror Global vs Override (Per-Setting Control)

For each setting, choose:

> **Mirror Global (default)**

* Always uses your normal global `options.txt` value

> **Override**

* Profile forces a specific value

This lets you make profiles that only change what matters (like FOV + sensitivity) without duplicating everything.

**Screenshot**
![Image of a Donut SMP Profile with 1 Override](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf453183fa697aa557deeb3c6ff69a25c3b0bd3e.png)

---

### Profile Manager (In-Game)

Adds a **Profiles** button to the main Options screen that opens a profile list with:

* **Create**
* **Rename**
* **Duplicate**
* **Reset** *(with confirmation)*
* **Delete** *(with confirmation)*
* **Open Directory** *(one click to open the profile folder)*

**Screenshot**
![Profiles list showing multiple profiles + buttons visible](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/79f7d6cf8a5d1b68d1e8ee668eebdbc8551ab9da_0.webp)

---

### Profile Editor + Target Controls

Click any profile to edit it:

* A persistent footer/toast shows: **“Editing profile for: …”**
* Change what servers/worlds the profile applies to
* Configure what the profile overrides vs mirrors
  
* A dedicated **Edit Settings…** flow that:
  * Temporarily applies the profile
  * Lets you change settings through normal Minecraft options screens
  * Saves differences back into the profile
  * Restores your global settings on exit

**Screenshot**
![Profile editor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a116e5d5215586c42ec52328fcbe8f7b30979289.jpeg)

---

### Active Profile Indicator

Shows a small, unobtrusive label in the Options screen:

* **Active profile: `<name>`**
* **Active profile: Global** when none is active

This makes it obvious when it’s working.

**Screenshot**
![Active Profile Indicator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b4cf7f60e89b0a783b2ac4b0e7b85dad17b786d5_0.webp)

---

### Mod Menu Compatible

* If **Mod Menu** is installed, Professional Profiles appears like other mods and opens the same UI
* If not, everything still works via the Options button

**Screenshot**
![Mod Menu integration](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f2657acd7871f3dcc7fb7a06604aecb9533fbb44_0.webp)

---

## Compatibility

* Client-side only *(no server installation required)*
* Allows Resource Packs to be added to Profiles
* Fabric for Minecraft **1.21.11**
* Works alongside common client stacks (Sodium/Iris/etc.) because it only manages client settings

---

## Notes / Limitations

* This mod focuses on `options.txt` *(vanilla settings + most keybind entries)*
* Mods that store settings in separate config files won’t automatically be profiled
* When editing a targeted world/server's profile while in the targeted world/server, you will need to rejoin to apply changes.
